title: Verb + -ing
summary: Глаголы, после которых идёт **-ing**: особые формы (**having done, being done, not doing**), конструкции **mind me/my doing**, **catch someone doing** и устойчивые выражения.
ru:
## Что уже известно и что нового
Вы знаете, что после **enjoy, finish, mind, suggest** идёт форма **-ing**. На уровне Advanced важны тонкости: более длинный список глаголов, особые формы (**having done, being done, not doing**), вопрос «кто совершает действие» (**me** или **my**), конструкции с дополнением (**see someone doing**) и устойчивые выражения.

## Глаголы, после которых идёт -ing
Эти глаголы не сочетаются с to-infinitive напрямую: **admit, avoid, consider, delay, deny, detest, dread, escape, face, fancy, imagine, involve, mind, miss, postpone, put off, practise, recall, resent, resist, risk, suggest**.
> She **avoided answering** the journalist's question. — Она избегала отвечать на вопрос журналиста.
> The job will **involve travelling** abroad twice a month. — Работа предполагает поездки за границу дважды в месяц.
> The board has **put off making** a decision until spring. — Совет директоров отложил решение до весны.
> Would you **consider moving** to another city? — Вы бы рассмотрели переезд в другой город?

## Особые формы -ing
- **Perfect: having + V3** — действие было раньше главного. > He admitted **having taken** the money. — Он признал, что взял деньги. Часто достаточно простой формы: *admitted taking*.
- **Passive: being + V3** — действие совершают над подлежащим. > She hates **being interrupted**. — Она терпеть не может, когда её перебивают.
- **Negative: not + -ing**. > He regretted **not telling** her sooner. — Он жалел, что не сказал ей раньше.
> I remember **being taken** to the sea as a child. — Помню, как меня в детстве возили на море.

## Кто выполняет действие: me или my?
После **mind, imagine, resent, enjoy, understand, dislike, excuse, forgive** перед -ing можно назвать исполнителя. В нейтральной речи — **me / him / us**, в формальной — **my / his / our**.
> Do you mind **me opening** the window? — нейтрально.
> Do you mind **my opening** the window? — более формально.
> Excuse **my interrupting**, but the line is busy. — Простите, что перебиваю, но линия занята.
Если речь о неодушевлённом существительном, обычно берут общую форму без 's: *I resent the project being delayed*. Если -ing — подлежащее фразы, притяжательная форма звучит очень формально: *My opening the window upset her*.

## Глагол + дополнение + -ing
После **see, hear, watch, notice, catch, find, leave, imagine, keep** можно назвать, кто и что делает, и показать действие в процессе:
> I **caught** a man **trying** to open my car. — Я застал мужчину, пытавшегося вскрыть мою машину.
> Don't **leave** the engine **running**. — Не оставляйте двигатель работающим.
> I can't **imagine** you **living** abroad. — Не могу представить тебя живущим за границей.
> I won't **have** you **talking** to her like that. — Я не позволю тебе так с ней разговаривать.
С **see/hear + bare infinitive** действие воспринято целиком (*saw him cross the road*), с -ing — в процессе (*saw him crossing*).

## Устойчивые выражения с -ing
- **can't help doing**, **can't stand / can't bear doing**, **feel like doing**;
- **it's no use / it's no good / there's no point (in) doing**, **it's (not) worth doing**;
- **spend / waste time doing**, **have difficulty (in) doing**, **have trouble doing**, **be busy doing**;
- **to — предлог!** *look forward to, be used to, object to, be committed to, in addition to* — после них тоже -ing.
Глаголы **advise, allow, permit, forbid, recommend**: без дополнения идёт -ing (*We don't allow smoking*), с дополнением — to-infinitive (*We don't allow guests to smoke*).

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She suggested to go by train.~~ → She suggested **going** by train. / ...that we **go**.
- ~~I enjoyed to meet them.~~ → I enjoyed **meeting** them.
- ~~He admitted to have lied.~~ → He admitted **lying / having lied**.
- ~~I'm looking forward to hear from you.~~ → ...to **hearing** from you.
- ~~I mind to wait.~~ → I don't mind **waiting**.
en:
## What you know and what is new
You already know that verbs like **enjoy, finish, mind and suggest** are followed by the **-ing** form. At advanced level the details matter: a longer list of verbs, special forms (**having done, being done, not doing**), who does the action (**me** or **my**), patterns with an object (**see someone doing**) and fixed expressions.

## Verbs followed by -ing
These verbs do not take a to-infinitive directly: **admit, avoid, consider, delay, deny, detest, dread, escape, face, fancy, imagine, involve, mind, miss, postpone, put off, practise, recall, resent, resist, risk, suggest**.
> She **avoided answering** the journalist's question.
> The job will **involve travelling** abroad twice a month.
> Would you **consider moving** to another city?

## Special -ing forms
- **Perfect: having + past participle** shows that the action happened earlier. > He admitted **having taken** the money. The simple form is often enough: *admitted taking*.
- **Passive: being + past participle**. > She hates **being interrupted**.
- **Negative: not + -ing**. > He regretted **not telling** her sooner.

## Who does the action: me or my?
After **mind, imagine, resent, enjoy, understand, dislike, excuse, forgive** we can name the doer before the -ing form. In neutral English we use **me / him / us**; in formal English **my / his / our**.
> Do you mind **me opening** the window? (neutral)
> Do you mind **my opening** the window? (formal)
> Excuse **my interrupting**, but the line is busy.
With a thing (not a person) we normally use the plain noun: *I resent the project being delayed*.

## Verb + object + -ing
After **see, hear, watch, notice, catch, find, leave, imagine, keep** we can add an object and show an action in progress.
> I **caught** a man **trying** to open my car.
> Don't **leave** the engine **running**.
> I can't **imagine** you **living** abroad.
> I won't **have** you **talking** to her like that. (= I will not allow it)
After see/hear, a bare infinitive means the whole action (*saw him cross the road*); -ing means it was in progress (*saw him crossing*).

## Fixed expressions
- **can't help doing**, **can't stand / can't bear doing**, **feel like doing**;
- **it's no use / it's no good / there's no point (in) doing**, **it's (not) worth doing**;
- **spend / waste time doing**, **have difficulty (in) doing**, **be busy doing**;
- **to is a preposition** in *look forward to, be used to, object to, be committed to, in addition to* — so -ing follows.
With **advise, allow, permit, forbid, recommend**: no object means -ing (*We don't allow smoking*); with an object we use to-infinitive (*We don't allow guests to smoke*).

## Common mistakes
- ~~She suggested to go by train.~~ → She suggested **going** by train.
- ~~He admitted to have lied.~~ → He admitted **lying / having lied**.
- ~~I'm looking forward to hear from you.~~ → ...to **hearing** from you.
structure:
## Формы -ing
| Форма | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Простая | verb + -ing | She avoided **answering**. |
| Перфектная (раньше) | having + V3 | He admitted **having taken** it. |
| Пассив | being + V3 | I hate **being interrupted**. |
| Перфектный пассив | having been + V3 | He denied **having been warned**. |
| Отрицание | not + -ing | She regretted **not applying**. |

## Модели
| Модель | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Глагол + -ing | enjoy / avoid / risk + -ing | We risked **losing** the contract. |
| Глагол + исполнитель + -ing | mind / imagine + me / my + -ing | Do you mind **me/my sitting** here? |
| Глагол + дополнение + -ing | catch / find / leave + obj + -ing | I found her **crying**. |
| Предлог to + -ing | look forward to / be used to + -ing | I'm used to **working** nights. |
| Устойчивые | it's no use / can't help + -ing | It's no use **complaining**. |

exercises.title: Какая форма -ing?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в нужную форму после выделенного глагола (простая, having done, being done, not doing).

items.text: The manager admitted {{making|having made}} a serious mistake in the budget.
Nobody likes {{being criticised|being criticized}} in front of colleagues.
I regret {{not accepting|not having accepted}} their offer when I had the chance.
He risked {{losing}} his job by leaking the report.
The board has put off {{making}} a decision until March.
The old man denied {{being|having been}} at the scene that night.
I can't help {{feeling}} that something is wrong.
The new policy will involve {{retraining}} all the staff.

exercises.example: She denied (take) the money. → She denied **taking** the money.

exercises.title: To + -ing
exercises.instruction: Вставьте форму -ing: после этих выражений to — предлог.

items.text: I'm really looking forward to {{seeing}} you in Bishkek.
She isn't used to {{driving}} on the left yet.
We strongly object to {{being}} treated like children.
The company is committed to {{reducing}} its carbon emissions.
In addition to {{working}} full time, she studies in the evenings.
She admitted to {{feeling}} nervous before the presentation.

items.q: The shop assistant suggested ___ a different size.
I'd consider ___ the offer if the salary were higher.
The security guard caught her ___ the exam answers.
I look forward ___ from you soon.
We don't allow ___ in the laboratory.
He denied ___ anything about the plan.
I can't imagine her ___ a job like that.
It's no use ___ him; he never listens.
I remember ___ a prize at school, though I forget what for.
items.why: Пассив: действие совершали над говорящим — **being given**.

items.q: He admitted ___ the documents the day before the audit.
items.why: Подлежащее само совершило действие раньше: **having shredded**.

items.q: Would you mind ___ the window? It's freezing.
Excuse ___ late; the train was cancelled.
I found her ___ in the garden at midnight.
Do you fancy ___ out for dinner tonight?
She resented ___ the blame for her colleague's mistake.

exercises.title: Перепишите, используя -ing
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя глагол в скобках.

items.prompt: 'I didn't steal the money,' said Jack. (deny)
answers: Jack denied stealing the money.
Jack denied having stolen the money.

items.prompt: 'Why don't we take the earlier train?' said Mia. (suggest)
answers: Mia suggested taking the earlier train.

items.prompt: 'Sorry I forgot Anna's birthday,' said Ben. (apologise for)
answers: Ben apologised for forgetting Anna's birthday.
Ben apologized for forgetting Anna's birthday.
Ben apologised for having forgotten Anna's birthday.
Ben apologized for having forgotten Anna's birthday.

items.prompt: The job / travel / a lot. (involve, present simple)
answers: The job involves travelling a lot.
The job involves traveling a lot.

items.prompt: (I / look forward to / meet / your family)
answers: I look forward to meeting your family.
I'm looking forward to meeting your family.
I am looking forward to meeting your family.
It's not worth waiting any longer.
It is not worth waiting any longer.
It isn't worth waiting any longer.
She can't help laughing.
She cannot help laughing.

items.prompt: Express: Я терпеть не могу, когда меня перебивают. (hate / interrupt)
answers: I hate being interrupted.
I hate people interrupting me.

items.prompt: Он отрицал, что знал об этом.
answers: He denied knowing about it.
He denied having known about it.
He denied knowing about that.
He denied having known about that.

items.prompt: Я не могу не думать об этом.
answers: I can't help thinking about it.
I cannot help thinking about it.
I can't help thinking about that.
I can't stop thinking about it.
I can't stop thinking about that.

items.prompt: Вы не возражаете, если я открою окно?
answers: Do you mind my opening the window?
Do you mind me opening the window?
Would you mind my opening the window?
Would you mind me opening the window?
It's no use arguing with him.
It is no use arguing with him.
It's no good arguing with him.
It is no good arguing with him.
There's no point in arguing with him.
There is no point in arguing with him.
There's no point arguing with him.
There is no point arguing with him.

items.prompt: Мы подумываем о переезде в Лондон.
answers: We're considering moving to London.
We are considering moving to London.

items.prompt: Я видел, как он выходил из здания (действие в процессе).
answers: I saw him leaving the building.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя конструкции с -ing.

items.prompt: What do you really dislike doing at work or at home?
items.sample: I really dislike answering emails late in the evening.

items.prompt: What are you looking forward to this month?
items.sample: I'm looking forward to visiting my family at the weekend.

items.prompt: Is there something you regret not doing?
items.sample: I regret not learning to play the piano as a child.

items.prompt: What is it no use doing in your opinion?
items.sample: It's no use complaining about the weather.

items.prompt: What do you hate being asked?
items.sample: I hate being asked about my salary.
